cards.trick: доказанный инвариант NaN-модели (trusted: 0), мутант обязан падать

files.fp_proven_invariant.smt2:
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const x_nan Bool)
(declare-const x_val Int)
(declare-const r_nan Bool)
(declare-const r_val Int)
(assert (not x_nan))
(assert (or (and (< x_val 0) (= r_nan false) (= r_val 0))
            (and (not (< x_val 0)) (= r_nan x_nan) (= r_val x_val))))
(assert (not (and (not r_nan) (>= r_val 0))))
(check-sat)
